ashwagandha.name: Ashwagandha Root, Powder & Extract
specifications: Plant part, form, mesh size and moisture aligned to the buyer brief
Withanolide marker and analytical method confirmed for extract enquiries
HPLC and gravimetric results are reported separately and are not treated as interchangeable
COA and additional testing scoped to the approved lot
commercialForms: Root powder in buyer-defined mesh size
ashwagandha.whyBuyersKnowIt: One of India’s best-known botanicals, available as whole root, powder and specification-led extract routes.
ashwagandha.fieldDescription: Ashwagandha enquiries are separated by plant part and physical form. Whole root and powder requirements are aligned to mesh, moisture and microbiology, while extract enquiries additionally define solvent system, extract ratio, marker profile and analytical method.
